# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.0 Worker 3 (Slot 95 oe_aip_): 6 Dynamic Historical AI Personalities & Global Eurasian Diplomatic/Expansion Choreography (0 vanilla overrides, 0 ai_diplochance). Generated by gen_v120_epic_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Verified EU5 1.4.9 join_war_rules schema (complements oe_ai2_join_war_rules.txt; 0 key overlap).
# root = joining country, scope:war, scope:first_leader (side joined), scope:second_leader (opposing leader).
# Strictly is_ai = yes so player agency is never restricted.

# 1. Pre-1680 European AI powers do not intervene across continents in internal Japan / Korea wars
oe_aip_jwr_no_euro_in_sengoku = {
	join_war_disabled_trigger = {
		oe_aip_ai_active = yes
		current_year < 1680
		capital ?= { continent = continent:europe }
		exists = scope:first_leader
		exists = scope:second_leader
		NOT = { is_neighbor_of = scope:first_leader }
		NOT = { is_neighbor_of = scope:second_leader }
		scope:first_leader = {
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					region = region:japan_region
					region = region:korea_region
				}
			}
		}
		scope:second_leader = {
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					region = region:japan_region
					region = region:korea_region
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# 2. Landlocked / low-navy Eurasian AI powers do not join distant intercontinental colonial wars
oe_aip_jwr_no_landlocked_colonial_war = {
	join_war_disabled_trigger = {
		oe_aip_ai_active = yes
		OR = {
			has_ports = no
			navy_size < 10
		}
		capital ?= {
			OR = {
				continent = continent:europe
				continent = continent:asia
			}
		}
		exists = scope:first_leader
		exists = scope:second_leader
		NOT = { is_neighbor_of = scope:first_leader }
		NOT = { is_neighbor_of = scope:second_leader }
		scope:second_leader = {
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					continent = continent:america
					continent = continent:oceania
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# 3. Pre-1750 East Asian AI powers do not drag into non-Endgame intra-European wars
oe_aip_jwr_no_china_in_europe_wars = {
	join_war_disabled_trigger = {
		oe_aip_ai_active = yes
		current_year < 1750
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_on }
		capital ?= { sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia }
		exists = scope:first_leader
		exists = scope:second_leader
		NOT = { is_neighbor_of = scope:first_leader }
		NOT = { is_neighbor_of = scope:second_leader }
		scope:first_leader = {
			capital ?= { continent = continent:europe }
		}
		scope:second_leader = {
			capital ?= { continent = continent:europe }
		}
	}
}

# 4. Concert Neutral Buffer Protection: Concert AI members refuse to join aggressors attacking a Treaty Buffer State
oe_aip_jwr_concert_buffer_defense = {
	join_war_disabled_trigger = {
		oe_aip_ai_active = yes
		oe_aip_is_concert_member = yes
		exists = scope:war
		exists = scope:first_leader
		exists = scope:second_leader
		scope:war = {
			is_an_attacker = scope:first_leader
			is_a_defender = scope:second_leader
		}
		scope:second_leader = {
			oe_aip_is_concert_buffer = yes
		}
	}
}
